acceptance: compare_integrity follows renames: a test file that git reports as renamed between base and ref to a path that is still a test file (by the same rule as removed-test-file) (git diff --find-renames, the detection integrity.py already uses for ratchets) gives no removed-test-file finding, and its test functions are compared against the file at its new path, so a pure move yields no removed-test, and a test dropped or weakened during the move is still reported (removed-test, new-skip, assert-loss under the new path). A test file deleted without a rename target is still a removed-test-file. A test file renamed to a non-test name (for example tests/test_x.py -> tests/x_cases.py) is not followed: it stays a removed-test-file and its tests removed-test, because pytest no longer collects them (operator 2026-11-16)

Tests in tests/test_integrity_python.py: one that fails on the current behaviour (a git mv of a test file reports removed-test-file and removed-test) and one that a test dropped in the same move is still reported; existing integrity tests unchanged

On M16.6.5's branch (feature/rm-tests-files-move-into-unit-flows-cli-gui-and-repo-lanes-moves-only at c16b2d01 against its base 3affe0ea), specy-road integrity with this fix reports no removed-test-file or removed-test for the moved files; report the command and the remaining finding counts in READY
